description:
Get there dry? Glance at your wrist.

The next rain sits on your Apple Watch face: "IN 16 MIN" until a shower arrives, "FOR 20 MIN" while it lasts. You don't open an app or take out your phone. It's free, with no ads and no account.

ON YOUR WATCH FACE
• A small circle that counts down to the next rain, or to the end of it.
• A larger slot with the rain line for the time ahead.
• Corner and inline complications, and a widget for the Smart Stack.

IN THE APP
• The rain ahead as a graph: when it starts, when it stops and how hard it falls.
• In the Netherlands and the area around it, a radar map that plays the shower towards you. Turn the Digital Crown to step through it.

WHERE THE FORECAST COMES FROM
• The Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg and western Germany: the radar forecast of KNMI, the Dutch national weather institute. Up to two hours ahead in five-minute steps, with the radar map.
• Everywhere else: Apple Weather. The next hour where Apple has a next-hour forecast (for example the UK and Ireland), hour by hour in other countries. There is no radar map there.

HONEST ABOUT ITS DATA
• The app shows when its forecast was made.
• When the forecast is old, the face shows its time instead of a countdown.
• Missing data is never shown as dry.

PRIVATE
It uses your location to find your forecast, or you choose a place by name. Your exact position stays on your watch. There is no account, no advertising and no tracking.

Made for Apple Watch. There is no iPhone app.

Data: KNMI (CC BY 4.0) and Apple Weather.
promotionalText: Get there dry? The next rain on your Apple Watch face, without opening an app. Free, with no ads and no account.
